text: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, created the `[[...slug]]/route.ts` runtime endpoint, wrapped the layout in `CopilotKitProvider`, and added `CopilotSidebar` to the page. TypeScript type-checking passed cleanly (`npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0). However, the Next.js dev server repeatedly started and reported "Ready in ~325ms" but then crashed or became unreachable before I could curl the homepage or the `/api/copilotkit` endpoint; `npm run build` was also killed. No real `OPENAI_API_KEY` was present in the sandbox environment, so even if the server had stayed up, the copilot endpoint would have failed on actual LLM calls.
